caption:
You're carrying it alone. But the load was never meant for one back — someone was supposed to step under it with you. (Galatians 6:2 devotional)

You've been firing advice from a safe distance when the word "bear" means to actually lift and carry, to step under the weight beside someone. That's what God did — the sinless Christ didn't hold Himself apart; through the cross He became one with us and carried what was crushing us, bearing our griefs so He could say "I've been there too." You were never alone under your load, and now He sends you to step under someone else's.
